explanation: The vessel travels 180 nautical miles at 12 knots, taking 15 hours. Departing at 08:00 UTC gives a physical ETA of 23:00 UTC on 15 October. The port receiving window closes at 22:00 UTC, so the vessel misses it. The next opening is 18:00 UTC on 16 October. The required waiting time is 19 hours.
